description: Reference-only specifications archived from the active execution profile. Not a simulation configuration; the runtime does not load or merge this file.

nim_units_per_plane.conditions: One physical NIM per Plane, shared by four logical Cluster channels.

nim_tiles_per_plane.conditions: NIM is spatially partitioned into20tiles, one per SuperLane; each serves20Cores/80Macros.

nim_channels_per_tile.conditions: Four logical Cluster channels per tile share physical NIM resources; four is not four replicated physical NIMs.

nim_conversion_lanes.conditions: 64 FP32 conversion lanes in the Plane NIM output service, one FP32/lane/cycle. Design target for terminal result conversion; do not multiply by20NIMtiles to infer terminal writer throughput.

archival_reasons.nim_units_per_plane: NIM unit count was inventory only; no NIM unit allocator or FP conversion execution exists in the INT32 GEMM path.
archival_reasons.nim_tiles_per_plane: NIM tile count was inventory only; current INT32 writer timing uses the separate explicit int32_writer_bpc service.
archival_reasons.nim_channels_per_tile: Logical NIM channel count was inventory only; it does not allocate independent physical writers or schedule channels.
archival_reasons.nim_conversion_lanes: FP conversion-lane count was inventory only. Current GEMM outputs INT32 through an explicit bypass service and performs no FP conversion.
